why: Prettier, biome and dprint are npm dependencies: with no manifest there is nowhere to declare them, and the rule has no object to check. The `pass` side is a tree with JavaScript code and no package.json, and has to come out N/A and not `passou` — passing would be certifying as formatted a repository nobody looked into at all. The `fail` side proves the guard did not swallow the rule: with the manifest present and only eslint declared, the accusation still comes out.
